name: tight-70s-dry
description: Punch-preserving variant of tight-70s for a dry/focused/punchy 1970s drum bus — same Neve 1073 → dbx 160 → Studer A800 chain, but the tape is driven LESS (input +6 vs +10) so transients/punch survive, and the image is slightly tighter (width 0.88). Apply to a measured-balanced, transient-punched, dry bus (room out, snare bleed gated, overheads de-hatted). Built 2026-05-31.
intended_for: a dry, measured-balanced, transient-punched drum bus (see scripts/mix/balance_stems.py + shape_bands)
notes: Less tape drive than tight-70s (input 6 vs 10) keeps punch for a dry/punchy mix; pair with the dry measured balance + shape_bands punch upstream.
